letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Even the gentle February breeze seems to whisper your name, and I smile thinking of our wedding day that feels like a sweet secret between the stars. You are my forever cutie, the laughter in my work calls and the calm in my evenings. Thank you for turning ordinary moments into golden memories—I love you more with each heartbeat.
poem:
Across two cities, love finds its rhyme,  
Your smile, my compass, through space and time.  
In every sunrise, in every night’s glow,  
Together we bloom, forever we’ll grow.
